messages:
siva_oncall: Heads-up: HeliosHealth reporting a spike of 503s from hosted inference starting ~2026-04-02T14:02:47Z. Customer says ~15% of requests returned 503 in a 3-min window.

emma_support: they pasted an example response and trace, escalating to infra/eng.

emma_support: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-3b","input":"status?"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
x-request-id: req_9b7c
x-upstream-error: infer-worker-exit
```

pagerbot: :rotating_light: alert: infer-runner runner-eu-12 (pid 23011) exited unexpectedly (signal 11) at 2026-04-02T14:03:09Z

tom_infra: Sig11 -> SIGSEGV. Any recent config or model swaps in the EU pool?

emma_support: customer was on rw-3b:q4_0 (quant) and we had a scheduled KV-prefetch change as part of performance tweaks at 14:00.

siva_oncall: node journal snippet I pulled:
```
Apr 02 14:03:09 infer-runner[23011]: kv_prefetch: start prefetch for model rw-3b ctx 0x7f2b11e000
Apr 02 14:03:09 infer-runner[23011]: ERROR: memcpy invalid address
Apr 02 14:03:09 kernel: [ 987654.123456] infer-runner[23011]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f2b11eabc in libkvprefetch.so+0x1abc
Apr 02 14:03:10 systemd: infer-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=11/SEGV
```

jia_engineering: possible root cause: KV prefetch background thread racing with shard eviction -> use-after-free leading to segfault. That would crash the process and trigger 503s for in-flight requests.

tom_infra: immediate mitigations: 1) route impacted customers to stable non-prefetch pool, 2) pause the KV-prefetch flag rollout, 3) drain and restart runner nodes that saw crashes. Applying now.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: routing updated: HeliosHealth -> stable-no-prefetch by tom_infra
pagerbot: :white_check_mark: feature-flag kv-prefetch rollout paused by tom_infra

emma_support: customer reports errors dropped to ~0.8% within 45s after routing. They want confirmation their requests were delivered.

ops_oncall: client retries are being served by fallback pool; no user-visible data loss. Collecting cores and artifacts now.

jia_engineering: please collect from affected hosts:
- core dump for crashed pid (23011)
- `gdb --batch -ex "thread apply all bt full" /usr/bin/infer-runner core.* > /tmp/core-bt.txt`
- `sha256sum /opt/lib/libkvprefetch.so /usr/bin/infer-runner > /tmp/shasums.txt`
- `journalctl -u infer-runner --since "2026-04-02 13:50" --until "2026-04-02 14:10" > /tmp/runner-journal.log`
- `ls -l /var/cache/kv/*` and `cat /proc/meminfo`

tom_infra: uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/3581234567/ now, enabling core collection and pinned bucket.

jia_engineering: quick triage from core: crash inside libkvprefetch on free path: double-free on a shard entry when eviction raced with prefetch completion. Reproducer hypothesis: small context with interleaved concurrent prefetch + eviction + cancel.

emma_support: customer is asking for ETA to restore the quant+prefetch path. Any safe rollout plan?

jia_engineering: plan:
- patch: add atomic guard and refcount to shard entries (hotfix) to prevent double-free (small change, testable)
- short-term: re-enable quant variant without kv-prefetch enabled; keep prefetch disabled until patch lands
- long-term: add unit tests and fuzzing for prefetch/eviction races and a canary test that ramps prefetch under simulated eviction load

tom_infra: applying non-prefetch image to canary and will run soak for 30m. INF-4802 created to track runtime fix and canary gating.

siva_oncall: mitigation timeline: routing applied and canary paused -> customer back to acceptable error rate. Hotfix for double-free targeting deploy in 2 hours, patch owner jia_engineering. Postmortem assigned to jia_engineering, severity: high.

emma_support: CS updated HeliosHealth: temporary mitigation applied (traffic routed to stable pool), engineering is deploying hotfix, estimated time to restore safe prefetched quant path ~2-3 hours, will follow up.

pagerbot: incident INC-2026-3581234567 created by siva_oncall. Threads: #incidents #oncall #infra

jia_engineering: follow-up checklist for RCA and prevention:
- reproduce locally with small harness that interleaves prefetch and eviction
- add fuzz tests and CI gating for libkvprefetch.so
- add runtime flag `--prefetch-max-concurrency` and a safe default to avoid bursts that amplify races
- instrument metrics for prefetch queue depth and double-free rate (should be 0)

ops_oncall: I'll schedule a rolling restart of runners that hit SEGV to clear any corrupted shared caches once hotfix is deployed.

emma_support: customer acknowledged update. Closing loop after hotfix deployed and canary stable. :thumbsup:
